doc: blj-tas.ramp0's chain, which reached frame 2808 at 2 trees + Climb2 (kingloop-0070), then straight to the summit instead of its UpperPath, whose grounded Done it kept missing mid-air (ETA 0 at y 2860), then the King per hit.

legs.name: LakituHill
legs.doc: Tech::LakituSkip's Hill mode (objectives/src/extra/tech/lakituskip.rs): the slope superjump over Lakitu's box to the door.

legs.name: Blj
legs.doc: The checkerboard elevator BLJ (blj.rs bob-elevator: TAS 2026 f22551-22602). done_requires_next: Done only where Tech::PoleRedirect (the reference fold's tree objectives) can start, i.e. flying at the tree on the velocity ray, so the GA optimises the BLJ and the aim together (filtering the BLJ's own ends afterwards kept 1 of ~35).

legs.name: Redirect
legs.doc: Into the first tree at hyperspeed and out (poleredirect.rs; TAS 2026 f22607-22611: crouch slide +380). done_requires_next: an aim from which the climb to the second tree can start. Aimed at the second tree (6799, 2008, -5587) when that aim is offered.

legs.name: Climb
legs.doc: The jump at hyperspeed to the second tree (hyperclimb.rs pole targets; TAS: JUMP vy 131 fv 298 to the tree at (6799, 2008, -5587), +1080).

legs.name: Redirect2
legs.doc: The second tree's redirect (TAS +278), aimed at the summit place (1900, 4293, -5900) when offered.

legs.name: Climb2
legs.doc: Hyperspeed into height (hyperclimb.rs, the generic +1000 objective): from the second tree's redirect the summit itself was 66 ETA frames short (rollouts topped out at y ~3100 by (3700, 3050, -6850); the TAS chains a wall kick and a double jump), so climb what the speed gives and walk the rest.

legs.name: KingIntro
legs.doc: Reach the King until his intro dialog opens: the only leg of the fight where a dialog ends the leg.

legs.name: KingHit1
legs.doc: One hit. No "dialogs": "stop": a dialog here (his return after a throw off the summit) is not Done.

phases.doc: Holding him: steer at the summit's middle; a throw predicted to land off the hill (or him off it) costs his way back (~105), DIALOG_128 (~90) and the regrab (~35).
